    Block quivers #

    A block quiver over monomial data D with block space V is a finite set of positions over vertices, partial injective arrow moves between positions, and a linear isomorphism of V on each move. The arrow a sends the block V at position i to the block at next a i through g a i. If no directed walk spells a zero path, P → V is a representation (toRep). String modules (V = k) and band modules (V with an automorphism on one move) are block quivers.
